description: Large mass centered on the anterior corpus callosum extending into both frontal lobes. It has cystic and enhancing components with a small focus of calcification. Superiorly there is a small a fluid- fluid level suggestive of intratumoural hemorrhage. Anterior horns of the lateral ventricles are effaced but there is no hydrocephalus.
